deities.name: Eirzunet
deities.rationale: Nocturnal life, shadowed architecture, and perception beyond ordinary light align with twilight and forbidden shadow.
deities.public_understanding: Recognized as a divine patron or associated deity within Universalian religious tradition.

deities.name: Sokhivar
deities.rationale: Despite their nocturnal habits, their avian bodies and aerial culture preserve an inherited association with the sky.
deities.public_understanding: Recognized as a divine patron or associated deity within Universalian religious tradition.

deities.name: Raeshkul
deities.rationale: Social echolocation that reads spatial and emotional tension is treated as a disciplined form of higher perception.
deities.public_understanding: Recognized as a divine patron or associated deity within Universalian religious tradition.

note: These are broad cultural associations rather than compulsory worship; households, regions, and individuals may honor other deities.
